contract.name: Image

props.description: Fallback URL, used when no `srcset` candidate or `source` applies.
props.name: src

props.description: Text alternative, required. `alt=""` is refused unless `decorative` says the image carries no information.
props.name: alt

props.description: The image carries no information: renders `alt=""`, and `alt` must be empty.
props.name: decorative

props.description: Intrinsic width in px of `src`; with `height` it reserves the box before the bytes arrive.
props.name: width

props.description: Intrinsic height in px of `src`; with `width` it reserves the box before the bytes arrive.
props.name: height

props.description: Width divided by height, reserved when the intrinsic size is unknown (or to crop to another shape with `fit`). One of `ratio` or `width` and `height` is required.
props.name: ratio

props.description: Width- or density-described candidates of the same picture, from the app's pipeline.
props.name: srcset

props.description: Slot widths the browser uses to pick a `w`-described candidate.
props.name: sizes

props.description: `<picture>` sources tried in order before the `img` — a modern format (AVIF, then WebP) or an art-directed crop. Omitted, a bare `img` renders.
props.name: sources

props.description: The Largest Contentful Paint candidate: fetched at high priority, eagerly, and decoded synchronously. Defaults to `false` — lazy loading and async decoding.
props.name: priority

props.description: Overrides the loading strategy `priority` implies; rarely needed.
props.name: loading

props.description: How the picture fills its reserved box: `cover` (default) crops, `contain` letterboxes.
props.name: fit

props.description: The focal point kept in frame when `cover` crops. Defaults to `center`.
props.name: position

props.description: Extra classes merged onto the `img`.
props.name: class

contract.purpose: A picture that requires its alternative, reserves its box from intrinsic dimensions or a ratio, and loads lazily unless marked as the priority (LCP) image; srcset and picture sources come from the app's own asset pipeline.
